top_signals.title: Brent Drops Below $90 as Wall Street Splits on 2027 Oil Outlook
top_signals.summary: Brent crude will average $80 per barrel in 2027 as geopolitics and relatively low global inventories leave much of the world vulnerable to supply disruptions, Bank of America said in a new note. Brent fell 2.9% to 89.86 dollars by 9:02 a.m. ET on Monday, and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dropped 2.9% to 80.96 dollars. The bank kept its 2027 Brent forecast unchanged and projected the benchmark at $70 in 2028, with WTI at $74 and $66 over the same two years. BofA named geopolitics as the main force on prices and forecast global oil demand growth…
